title: Reference: 200 ms windows, 95 % overlap, shuffled, state reset · 4th-order envelope
description: First round, 4th-order envelope low-pass (about 230 ms lag); kept for comparison with the 2nd-order round. The setting every other entry of this study changes in exactly one way: 20 steps of 10 ms (200 ms), a new window every 10 ms (95 % overlap), windows shuffled every epoch, LSTM state reset at every window. Everything else as the reference: Active torque (each session's own relaxed-hold passive torque subtracted), EMG ÷ session-1 maximum, per-angle loss scaling, LSTM 8×2 trained with batch 64 (fast protocol: learning rate × 0.5 after 6 flat epochs, early stop 15, at most 150 epochs), trained on session 1 and tested on session 2, 6 people × 10 seeds. The EMG envelope is causal (forward-only filters: no input uses later EMG, as in a real-time device) and the first and last 1 s of every trial are cut.
